FAQs – Sofas & Armchairs
How do I choose the right sofa for my living room?
Start by measuring your available space and considering your seating needs. A
2-seater sofa

Start by measuring your available space and considering your seating needs. A
2-seater sofa
works well in compact apartments, while
3-seater, sectional, or L-shaped sofas

3-seater, sectional, or L-shaped sofas
are ideal for larger living rooms and families. Consider the sofa's Material, comfort level, and style to match your décor.

Which sofa material is best for everyday use?
For everyday use,
fabric sofas

For everyday use,
fabric sofas
are a popular choice due to their comfort and variety of colors and textures. If you're looking for a premium look and easy cleaning,
leather or leather-look sofas

leather or leather-look sofas
can be a practical option.
Are sofa beds suitable for daily use?
Yes, many
sofa beds

sofa beds
are designed for both comfortable seating and sleeping. They are an excellent solution for smaller homes, guest rooms, and multi-functional spaces where maximizing room usage is important.

What is the difference between a sectional sofa and an L-shaped sofa?
A
sectional sofa
consists of multiple modular pieces that can often be rearranged to suit your space, while an
L-shaped sofa

L-shaped sofa
has a fixed corner design. Both provide ample seating and help make the most of living room layouts.
How do I maintain and clean my sofa?

How do I maintain and clean my sofa?
Regular vacuuming helps remove dust and debris. For fabric sofas, check the care instructions before cleaning stains. Many IKEA sofas come with

removable and washable covers
, making maintenance easier and helping keep your sofa looking fresh.
Are armchairs suitable for small spaces?
Absolutely. Compact
armchairs and accent chairs

Absolutely. Compact
armchairs and accent chairs
can add extra seating without taking up too much room. They can also create a cozy reading corner or complement your existing sofa arrangement.
How long should a quality sofa last?
A well-made sofa can last for many years with proper care. The lifespan depends on factors such as frame construction, upholstery quality, usage, and maintenance practices.

What's the best sofa for a small apartment?
For smaller spaces, consider a
2-seater sofa, loveseat, compact sectional, or sofa bed

Can I mix and match sofas and armchairs?
Yes. Mixing different sofas and armchairs can create a more personalized and visually appealing living room. Choose complementary colors, materials, or styles to maintain a cohesive look.
